resources.string: Optional unverified Instagram diagnostic. With fresh report consent, Doom traverses only an Instagram accessibility root and keeps one bounded sanitized structural report containing static Instagram resource names (64 unique tokens, 8,192 ASCII characters). A separate default-off diagnostic consent shows a five-second accessibility overlay on the first verified Instagram foreground event regardless of classifier result, including DM and unknown surfaces, and displays the sanitized result FEED, REELS, STORIES, MESSAGING, or UNKNOWN. A positively identified direct return to Doom preserves the latest report only after the overlay detaches; other Doom-owned overlay events and foreign apps do not trigger preservation, and safety paths clear it. It never keeps UI text, descriptions, notification content, account data, screenshots, raw trees, bounds, or node/window IDs, and never logs, persists, uploads, or performs Instagram node actions. The overlay has immediate Dismiss and Leave Instagram buttons. Turn off either consent at any time.
